cohort: Women with PCOS who delivered singletons (n=190) or twins (n=79) via IVF/ICSI
finding: Higher maternal preconception fasting plasma glucose and HbA1c were associated with lower singleton birthweight in women with PCOS.
mod_finding: An interaction effect was observed between elevated 2hPI and twin birthweight in overweight women and between HbA1c and singleton birthweight in those who had Cesarean deliveries.
birth_weight: Neonatal birthweight was measured for all infants.
